towns.name: Ashvale Crossing
towns.subtitle: The town beneath the split shrine bell
towns.description: A trade town built around an old Guardian shrine. Since the bell cracked, violet Ether seeps through the market stones at dusk.
towns.ambientLine: The shrine bell hums even when there is no wind.

towns.name: Mirefen Reach
towns.subtitle: A drowned settlement of blue lanterns
towns.description: A wetlands town where water Ether gathers in the reeds. The people fear that Nerevan's tide has begun answering something beneath the marsh.
towns.ambientLine: Every reflection in the marsh looks half a second late.

towns.name: Stormglass Bastion
towns.subtitle: A fortress where lightning sleeps in the walls
towns.description: A military bastion carved from black glass and copper. Its towers catch storms and teach soldiers to move between thunderbeats.
towns.ambientLine: The air tastes like copper and unfinished warnings.
